newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rise on back of Lek and Luka.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rise on back of Lek and Luka.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended 0.58 percent higher, pulled up by gains in market heavy weights drug maker Lek and port operator Luka.
"Prices obviously reached their bottom, I think this correction could extend into the first two days of the next week," one broker said.
* The SBI index firmed 6.93 points to 1,200.8.
* Drug maker Lek rose 1.73 percent to 21,780 tolars on volume of 396 shares.
* Luka Koper rose 1.90 percent to 1,610 tolars on volume of 721 shares.
* Mineral water producer and health resort holder Radenska was the top gainer, jumping 4.35 percent or 65 tolars to 1,560 on volume of 1,284 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
